source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 220K-like carousel presents an Ami Paris Fall/Winter lookbook — a male model in a long camel overcoat over a brown pinstripe three-piece suit with an unbuttoned red-and-white striped shirt and black boots, posed at a bright white colonial-style building; the set closes with a handwritten card from the runway and a close-up of the garments. A 21K-like carousel models Tommy Hilfiger fall outfits around New York — a black pantsuit with a burgundy blouse, a tan coat with a fur collar, a varsity jacket over a white blouse with a plaid midi skirt, and a maroon varsity jacket with plaid wide-leg pants. A 17K-like reel cycles through fall/winter layering looks — a plaid shirt-dress with a grey cable-knit sweater, a cream off-the-shoulder cable-knit sweater dress with a grey plaid coat and knee-high boots, a mint-green fuzzy peplum cardigan, a brown ribbed midi dress under a faux-fur wrap coat, and a cream Fair Isle sweater with a tweed cape. An 18K-like carousel builds three fall-winter outfits around a black-and-white houndstooth fringed coat-dress with bright red stilettos, a black faux-leather top with a tiger-stripe midi skirt, and a monochromatic bright-red faux-leather ensemble with a beret. A 13K-like carousel styles a coordinated maroon look — a ribbed cropped knit cardigan with fringe cuffs, matching stirrup leggings, burgundy leather gloves and a black Dior saddle bag. A 13K-like carousel documents a SpaceNK Christmas getaway party — matching red Santa-print pajamas, burgundy party outfits, a shiny silver puffer over a red knit romper, and a long fitted burgundy dress.
trends.title: Camel overcoats and pinstripe tailoring lead the fall lookbook wave

trends.details: A 190K-like reel tours a cozy maximalist Christmas home — a woman on a step ladder tops a huge tree covered in multicolor lights and vintage-style ornaments, with the on-screen line 'It's dark by 5pm because you're supposed to have your christmas lights up'; the camera pans across pink striped curtains, garlands with colored bulbs, a dining table with reindeer figurines and gingerbread decor, and a garland-draped kitchen. A 59K-like reel unpacks holiday decor from a storage bin in white Christmas pajamas — pinecones, gold-wrapped ornaments, brass bells, black metal reindeer, wooden trees and greenery garlands — building a coffee-table centerpiece, a mantel garland with bells, stockings, a wreath on a round mirror and miniature lit ceramic houses. A 36K-like reel pushes through a doorway framed in dense silver tinsel garland covered in ornaments, bows and candy canes into a room with a brightly lit tree, a greenery-draped mantel and rainbow ceiling streamers, captioned 'It's tiiiiime!' A 35K-like reel documents a 14-hour vintage tree build with about 1,000 ornaments, 95% thrifted, adding colorful C9 lights by hand and a Christopher Radko Disney nutcracker ornament. A 25K-like reel presents a 'Creative Holiday Edit' tree in checkered pajamas — red baubles, black-and-white checkered ornaments, a yellow traffic light, a red stop sign, a Woody doll and a plush Mickey, topped with a sign reading 'THE CREATIVE.' A 24K-like reel centers on a tree with red bows and white-and-gold ornaments above an illuminated miniature Christmas village on a snowy mat, a train circling past tiny lit houses, a windmill and figurines, while two cats wander through the scene.
trends.title: It's dark by 5pm — maximalist Christmas lights go up early

trends.details: An 80K-like tutorial builds holiday eye makeup for hooded eyes — a folded cotton round as a shield while dark purple shadow from a Morphe palette defines the crease, then a shimmery pink shade on the lid, finished with mascara for a soft smoky purple eye with winged liner, glossy nude lips and gold hoops. A 41K-like 'GRWM FOR DIWALI' tries Indian makeup for the first time — warm-toned eyeshadow, gel winged liner, shimmery highlighter on the lids and brown lip liner with gloss, paired with a sari sent by a friend. A 35K-like reel shares '2 Holiday Makeup Hacks for Hooded Eyes' — a cotton pad shield for a clean dark-purple edge, then tape at the outer corner to map the crease with reddish-brown shadow and a shimmery silver-green lid. A 30K-like reel demos '3 easy christmas makeup hacks' — a Santa hat stamped on the forehead with an eyelash curler dipped in red liquid lipstick, bauble dots on the cheek drawn with a green pen, and a snowflake etched into red blush with a toothpick dipped in micellar water. A 27K-like transformation tutorial walks through a soft-glam look — liquid foundation and concealer, pink blush, contour and eyeshadow from a multi-pan palette, winged liner, mascara, lip liner and gloss. An 18K-like clip applies a deep berry lipstick from a gold case with a red gem detail, captioned 'deep berry lips for winter >>.'
trends.title: Hooded-eye holiday glam and Christmas makeup hacks
